note: The input buffer is accepted for gzip detection even when it is shorter than the full fixed gzip header; two bytes are enough to reach the gzip-specific path.
The two-byte signature match on 0x1f 0x8b selects the gzip decompression entry.
The gzip decoder reads the fourth header byte before verifying that the input contains the full fixed 10-byte gzip header.
